catalog.name: FormTools
catalog.summary: Viewers for almost any file, batch image tools, 3D viewing and desktop utilities in one window.

notes_for_owner: UNTESTED: first formtools entry, modelled on formpath and formdesign (contract mode). The launcher has install, install-desktop and 'desktop build [--config F]' (setup/desktop_build passes its arguments to tauri build); formtools.bat shifts 'desktop build' off before calling setup\desktop_build.bat, so cmd contract mode works on Windows. bundle.targets is 'all'. minimumSystemVersion 12.0 in tauri.conf.json. The updater public key is empty, so the app skips update checks until a key pair is made. Catalogue entry follows formai.studio's catalog/products.json.
